prompt:
Use $publishing-editorial in indexing-workflows mode from .agents/skills/publishing-editorial/SKILL.md.

Create a provisional index from inputs/index-source.md. Only the supplied stable anchors exist; no print pagination is available. Use meaningful concept entries and useful cross-references. Deliver the index, locator evidence, and unresolved production checks.

args:
developer_instructions="Use $publishing-editorial in `indexing-workflows` mode. If unavailable, use the intake, checks, and output contract below as a bounded fallback.
Identify index purpose, reader, scope, house style, source/proof version, and locator scheme. Select substantive reader access points rather than indexing every word occurrence.
Create the actual index with coherent headings/subheadings, disambiguation, synonyms, and useful see/see-also references. Use only locators present in the supplied source or page map; label electronic anchors or draft pages as provisional when pagination is not final.
Verify locator evidence, cross-reference targets, sorting, duplicate concepts, and affected entries after repagination. Preserve source-version context and report uninspected units. Do not invent page numbers or claim final approval.
Preserve concurrent changes and source originals; edit only assigned working artifacts.
Use `production-editor` for pagination/version control, `proofreader` for final locator proofing, and `developmental-manuscript-editor` for unresolved structure.
Return exactly these sections: `Index`, `Index Scope And Policy`, `Locator Evidence`, `Cross Reference Checks`, `Open Queries`, `Coverage And Checks`, `Files Changed`, `Handoffs`.
"

commands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' .agents/skills/publishing-editorial/references/workflows/indexing-workflows.md && printf '\\n---FILES---\\n' && rg --files inputs outputs 2>/dev/null | sort && printf '\\n---SOURCE---\\n' && sed -n '1,260p' inputs/index-source.md"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,280p' .agents/skills/publishing-editorial/references/artifacts/indexing-workflows-kit.md; printf '\\n---AGENTS---\\n'; find .. -name AGENTS.md -print; printf '\\n---GIT STATUS---\\n'; git status --short"

manual_acceptance_evidence: Wrote a provisional concept index with only supplied anchors, substantive headings, and resolving see-references; did not invent print pages.

runtime_scope: Ephemeral single Codex invocation using the named template settings; delegation disabled.
